summary: Set baseDomain to the host's DNS name (e.g. rhem-example.com) so URLs and certificates are right; enable and start flightctl.target and check the 7 services flightctl-db, -kv, -api, -periodic, -worker, -ui and -cli-artifacts; open the UI at baseDomain and debug with journalctl -u flightctl-<service> -b --no-pager.
